normalize.why: period inside one month: the last day
period across a year end: the end's own year
a day the month does not have is not a date
another spelling is kept as text, unusable
no prize field: no text either
a stated prize of 0 is known
a currency prefix not listed: the amount stays unknown
and its text is kept as shown
a place with the map marker is in person
a place with another icon: unknown
the bare domain is not a hackathon page
